hero.tagline: 5A1F Studio joins software engineering with game art to craft precise independent experiences, from the first idea to the last detail.

about.label: About us
about.title: Three paths, one studio.
about.body: 5A1F was born where programming meets visual art: Amin (Abu Othman) from Morocco in software, games, and 2D/3D design; Abdul Samad from Palestine in 3D art and artistic productions; and Emad from Sudan in programming. We work deliberately and prefer correct details over big promises.
about.quote: We make what we love to play.
about.teamSubtitle: Every member owns a full craft. Open any card for the full profile.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We respect our visitors. This page explains what we collect and what we do not, in plain language.
privacy.dataBody: 5A1F has no server and no database. We store no personal data on this site. The join form and the service request form assemble WhatsApp messages or email drafts inside your browser only, then hand them to the app you choose so you can send them yourself.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use no tracking or advertising cookies. We only store your local preferences (language, audio, motion) in localStorage on your device.
privacy.contactBody: For any privacy question, use the official studio channel on the contact page.
